svg.title: Stack grouped by deploy, secure and observe
svg.desc: Deploy: AWS EC2, ALB, Auto Scaling, Linux, Docker, GitHub Actions, Ansible, Nginx, Python, Bash, Lambda, API Gateway, Bedrock, Strands Agents; learning Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm. Secure: IAM, KMS, Vault Lock, Security Groups, VPC, Cognito; learning cloud security. Observe: CloudWatch, Grafana; learning Prometheus.
